_meta.description: Student stories — both completed (status: past) and active (status: current).
_meta.guidance: Past stories show outcome + invested. Current stories show raised/goal/sponsors/days.

stories.name: Silpa
stories.headline: Shilpa quit school at 11 to take care of mom. Now she's a nurse.
stories.summary: At eleven, Silpa had dropped out of school to care for her asthmatic mother. Today she's a working nurse who built the first brick home in her village.
stories.outcome: Working as a nurse, Shilpa built the first brick home in her village.

stories.name: Megana
stories.headline: She was cleaning houses at seven. Today she cares for patients at a hospital.
stories.summary: Megana started attending Sunday school at nine and cleaning houses at seven to support her family. Generous sponsors helped her through nursing college. Four years later, she's a working nurse helping her sister through college.
stories.outcome: Working nurse · helping her sister through college
